text:
**Fix: Mega index-column sum uses the wrong padding.** Doc §3 says "On 3232 Mega, the columns are 3376 (3232 + 2 × 72)" but §2's own table sets Mega `section-pad` to 128, which would give 3488, not 3376 — either justify why that one column uses Desktop's 72 instead of its own mode's padding, or correct the number.

**Note: Root size doesn't match the doc.** §"The lab page" states "5520 × 3068"; the actual Root (`332:3`) measures 5520 × 3158 (checked live) — update the number.

Everything else checks out:
- Column math confirmed live: 3 columns × 1744 + 2×72 gaps + 2×72 padding = 5520, matches the proposal exactly.
- Every width sum in §1 (512, 1056, 1056 alt compositions, 1600 variants, 3232) recomputes correctly by hand.
- Specimen (`337:165`) matches §4 exactly: label = component name, one fact line, purple-outlined stage at the master's real width, 2-3 lines of notes, Kicker/Title/Body layer names present.
- "Two Desktops … drawn at half size" row is already flagged as a known gap in the doc itself — not a new defect.
- 1:1 crops show no cropping, floating, or misalignment; nothing outside Root.

Verdict: fix (two small doc-text corrections, nothing on the canvas).
